name: Zephagamon
main_effect:
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
＜Vortex＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] Suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspended your Digimon, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
